newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 2.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Zhou Daojiong, Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has said that listing Chinese firms on the overseas markets is a long-term strategy.
- Hebei Taihang Cement Co is expected to be the first Chinese firm to be listed in Australia and its initial public offering is expected within this year.
- Commentary says China will be able to hit the target of keeping inflation rate under six percent this year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai issues rules on managing road traffic and video and audio products.
- Shanghai registers business consultants for the first time with 619 experts given licences.
- Commentary says Shanghai should set up conglomerates with the aim to compete with world-class multinationals.
